A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''member''' of the [[Sunrider family]] was the [[Human/Legends|Human]] son of [[Jev Sunrider]] and the [[Parent/Legends|father]] of [[Andur Sunrider]]. He lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Darada]] with other members of his family, and owned a small [[Garden/Legends|garden]] on his families' land in which Andur worked in.<ref name="TOTJ Companion" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:AndurS.jpg|thumb|left|132px|Andur Sunrider worked in his father's garden at home.]]
This unidentified Sunrider was briefly mentioned in the entry for Andur Sunrider in the ''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'', when it was said that, while at home, Andur worked in his father's garden.<ref name="TOTJ Companion" />
